glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形): a running man. An additional 止 (“foot”) was added later. The variant form 𧺆 preserves the form in the Small Seal Script. In the modern form, the top component (夭) is simplified to the unrelated 土 and the bottom part is stylized as 龰. See also the top component of 去 and 赤. As with 圭, there are two separate vertical strokes, not a single one.
senses: [zǒu] to go; to walk; to go on foot
[zǒu] (literary, dialectal Mandarin, Cantonese, Hakka, Min, Wu) to run; to jog
